mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.user_id, u.username, u.real_name, r.equipment_id, e.name AS equipmentName, e.code AS equipmentCode, e.image AS equipmentImage, r.lab_id, l.name AS labName, r.date, r.end_date, r.start_time, r.end_time, r.purpose, r.status, r.approve_comment, r.return_image, r.return_note, r.returned_at, r.create_time FROM reservation r LEFT JOIN `user` u ON r.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN equipment e ON r.equipment_id = e.id LEFT JOIN lab l ON r.lab_id = l.id WHERE r.id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservation WHERE equipment_id = #{equipmentId} AND status = 'APPROVED' AND (IFNULL(end_date, date) > CURDATE() OR (IFNULL(end_date, date) = CURDATE() AND end_time > CURTIME()))

SELECT CONCAT(LPAD(MONTH(date), 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(DAY(date), 2, '0')) AS date, COUNT(*) AS count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approved FROM reservation WHERE date >= TIMESTAMPADD(DAY, -6, CURDATE()) GROUP BY date ORDER BY date
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM reservation GROUP BY status
SELECT IFNULL(l.name, '未知实验室') AS labName, COUNT(r.id) AS count FROM reservation r LEFT JOIN lab l ON r.lab_id = l.id GROUP BY r.lab_id, l.name ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT #{limit}
